transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Doctor. Um... well, I really hope it's okay that I'm here, I don't want to take up too much of your time. I mostly came in because... well, my husband and the people at the warehouse, they keep acting like I'm... like I'm crazy, I guess? Which I'm not, I promise. I'm a really good worker. 

It's just... I know they've been, um, watching my moves on the floor. And they keep changing my pallet counts when I'm not looking. I think they're just doing it to keep me from getting that supervisor spot, you know? Does that make sense? I'm just trying to do my job right, I swear.
About how long have you been noticing this happening at work?

Um, well... I guess it's been a little while. I hope I'm not complaining too much, I really am grateful for my job. But I'd say it's been about eight months now? 

That's when I first started getting that feeling that they were watching me and, you know, changing my stuff around on the floor. And... um... I really hope you don't judge me or think I'm weird for saying this, but... that's also around when I started hearing the, um, the voices. Just a little bit, though! I try really hard to just work through it and ignore them so I don't cause any trouble for anyone. 

Am I... am I giving you the right kind of answers? I just want to make sure I'm being helpful.
You are doing great, and your answers are very helpful. Over these past eight months, have you felt persistently down, sad, or depressed?

Oh, thank you so much, Doctor. That makes me feel a lot better, I was really worried I was messing this up somehow. 

Um... as for feeling sad or down... no, not really. I hope that's okay! I just... I don't really get depressed. I try to be a really upbeat person, you know? Even with all the weird stuff going on at the warehouse, I always make sure to keep a smile on my face so I don't bother anyone else or bring the team's mood down. I'm usually pretty energetic. 

So, no, no real sadness. Is that... is that the kind of answer you needed? I just want to be sure I'm not leaving anything out that you're supposed to write down.
Have you used any recreational drugs, or taken any medications not prescribed to you, during these past eight months?

Oh, no, definitely not! I promise, I don't do anything like that. I know some of the guys at the warehouse might, you know, smoke a little something on their breaks, but I always just stay away from it. I don't want to get in trouble or lose my job. 

And I definitely wouldn't take anyone else's pills or anything. I just try to drink a lot of coffee to keep my energy up for my shifts, but that's it! I hope that's a good thing? I just really want to do the right thing and be a good patient for you.
Could you tell me what the voices say when you hear them?

Um... well... I really hope this doesn't make me sound crazy. I know it sounds a little strange, but I promise I'm still doing my job well! 

It's just... sometimes, like when I'm in the aisle at work, or even just at home folding my clothes, I'll hear this man's voice. It's clear as day, like he's standing right next to me, but... nobody's there. He usually just says something like, "Nicole, check it again." 

It's not mean or anything, I swear! It's just... there. I try to just double-check whatever I'm doing and keep working, so I don't let it bother anyone else. Does... does that make sense? I hope I explained that okay for you.
Have you ever had a period lasting several days where you felt unusually energized, wired, or on top of the world?

Um... well... I guess maybe a little bit? I mean, I really try to just be a hard worker and stay positive. Sometimes I do get these stretches where I feel... I don't know, just really fired up? Like I have all this energy and nobody can slow me down. It's actually great for getting things done at the warehouse! 

But... um... I feel really bad admitting this. Sometimes when I'm like that, I can get a little... snappy? Like, if my husband asks me just one tiny little question about the kids or what my schedule is for the week, I just... I snap at him. It feels like he's trying to control me or something, and I just get so irritated. 

I always apologize after, I swear! I know it's not very nice of me. I really try to be a good wife and mom. Is... is it bad that I get like that sometimes? I hope that doesn't mean I'm a terrible person or anything. I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right answers.
Have you heard the voices or felt people were watching you during times when your mood and energy felt completely normal, rather than high or fired up?

Um... well... yes. I... I hope that's okay to say. I don't want you to think I'm making things up or that I'm completely losing it. I really try to keep it together, I promise!

But... yeah, even when I'm not feeling all fired up, it still happens. Like, there was a stretch a little while ago, maybe a few weeks, where things were pretty quiet. I was sleeping better, not racing around the warehouse or snapping at my husband... just feeling, you know, normal. 

But even then, I still heard the man's voice telling me to check things. And... um... I still felt like someone was messing with my work. I was so sure people were changing the pallet counts just to make me look bad. I really didn't want to cause any trouble, so I just kept my head down and kept checking them like the voice said. 

Is... is that helpful? I hope I'm explaining this right. I just really want to give you all the information you need so I can be a good patient.
When you have those times where you feel especially fired up and full of energy, about how long do those stretches usually last?

Um... well, it's a little hard to say exactly, but... I guess those fired-up times have been sort of coming and going for maybe the last six months or so? 

I mean, I don't want to make it sound like I'm totally out of control for half the year! It's not like that. It's just... I'll have these days where I'm super wired, and I barely need any sleep at all, and I just take on way too much at work and at home. And then it'll stop, and then maybe it comes back again later. 

I really try to channel all that extra energy into being productive, so I'm still doing a good job! I just... I hope that's the kind of answer you were looking for. Is six months about what you'd expect? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right timeline.
